description: Subtract the scaled R channel of an RGB view from an Ha view, in place. Ha = max(0, Ha - continuum_factor * R). Runs as 64-bit PixelMath truncated to [0,1]; reports the new median and max.

continuum_factor.description: Multiplier on R subtracted from Ha

rgb_id.description: RGB view whose R channel is subtracted (same dimensions)

name: continuum_subtract_ha
